subtitle_zh: Victor Haghani 与 Valerie Grimba 做客 ETF Edge：聊散户化时代的行为偏差、估值高企下的资产配置，以及 ETF 如何成为普通人的“精准”投资工具。

turns.en: ETF Edge is sponsored by State Street Investment Management, getting their starts here.
turns.zh: ETF Edge 由 State Street Investment Management 赞助播出——“抵达目标，始于此刻。”

turns.en: Welcome to ETF Edge, the podcast. If you're looking to learn the latest insights on all things exchange traded funds, you're in the right place. Every week we're bringing you compelling interviews, thoughtful market analysis, and breaking down what it all means for investors.
turns.zh: 欢迎收听播客版 ETF Edge。如果你想了解关于交易所交易基金（exchange-traded fund，ETF）的最新见解，那你来对地方了。每周我们都会带来精彩的访谈、有深度的市场分析，并为你拆解这一切对投资者意味着什么。

turns.en: I'm your host, Dominic Chiu. Now, risk may be elevated in the markets right now, but your own response to it may be the biggest risk of all. Plus, where can you find the best relative value in these types of markets? Here's my conversation with Victor Hagani,

turns.en: the Elmwell Founder and CIO alongside Valerie Grimba, RBC Capital Markets Director of Global ETF Strategy. Thank you both for being with us for the show today. I'd like to start maybe from an ETF perspective, Valerie, with you on this. We have seen a lot of gyration over the course
turns.zh: 他是 Elm Wealth 的创始人兼首席投资官（CIO），同场的还有 RBC Capital Markets 全球 ETF 策略总监 Valerie Grimba。感谢两位今天来做客我们的节目。Valerie，我想先从 ETF 的角度问你。过去三四个月市场经历了大幅震荡，

But the last couple of months have caught a lot of investor attention because it has been the leadership group that's been leading the rally that has been suffering

turns.zh: 总体来看，ETF 投资者表现出一种健康的倾向：愿意把资金继续投入他们相信有价值、相信长期走势的主题。这最终促成 ETF 资金流（fund flows）又一个创纪录的年份。我觉得它更多是

Of course, now with the additional ETF product proliferation, there's an entire new wheelhouse or toolset where these investors can get much more specific almost surgical-like precision with how they invest using ETFs
turns.zh: 投资者表达不同观点的一个入口或工具。当然，如今随着 ETF 产品大爆发，投资者有了一整套全新的工具箱，可以用 ETF 把投资做得更具体，甚至达到近乎外科手术式的精准，

turns.en: maybe if you wanted a sector-based fund. These days, there are specific industry ones, thematic ones, even small basket ETFs that capture just maybe a few stocks that give you that kind of exposure. Just how much more prevalent is the usage of the more surgical experience versus just
turns.zh: ——如果你想要板块型基金的话。而如今，有细分行业型的、主题型的 ETF，甚至还有只装几只股票的“小篮子”ETF，让你获得那类敞口（exposure）。相比单纯

Of course, index funds are still continuing to gather assets, but I think it has been a key driver of this next level of growth that we've seen. I think DRAM, we're talking about semiconductors, this is a perfect example of this.

turns.zh: 我只要买一只只持有 10 到 15 只股票的窄基 ETF，就知道自己抓住了这个主题。Victor，这类产品——就叫它们“精准型”产品吧——有意思的一点是，站在投资者或交易者的角度，你必须

turns.zh: 对所使用的产品、以及你承担的底层敞口，有相当更深的了解。你的职业生涯阅历丰富，从早年在 Salomon Brothers 做债券分析，到后来从事对冲基金（hedge fund）行业。那么

turns.zh: 大规模流入市值加权指数基金（market-cap-weighted index fund），主要渠道是 401(k) 和 IRA 投资；另一方面，非常具体的个性化投资又在爆发式增长。我不确定今天的投资者比 30 年前

turns.en: ago in the sense that I think we still are human beings and we're subject to certain kinds of biases, particularly extrapolation bias, where whatever has happened recently in the past, we tend to believe that it's going to continue into the future. I think when you were asking that question
turns.zh: 成熟了多少——毕竟我们仍然是人，会受某些偏差的影响，尤其是外推偏差（extrapolation bias）：近期发生过什么，我们就倾向于相信它会延续到未来。我想你刚才提问的时候，

turns.en: earlier, Dom, it got me thinking about how recently stocks have been all individual stocks have all been moving to their own beat. The dispersion has been very high among stocks. The correlation between stocks has been very low. This was supposed to be a time when active managers, when
turns.zh: Dom，让我想到最近个股都在按自己的节奏走。个股之间的离散度（dispersion）非常高，相关性非常低。按理说这应该是主动管理型（active）基金经理、

turns.en: stockpickers were just going to have a field day because that's what they needed. If all the stocks are moving in lockstep, it's hard to beat the market. These last two or three years according to Morningstar and S&P active fund managers have continued to do poorly. In fact, probably a little
turns.zh: 是选股者大显身手的时代，因为这正是他们需要的环境。如果所有股票齐步走，就很难跑赢市场。可过去两三年，根据 Morningstar 和 S&P 的数据，主动型基金管理人依然表现不佳，事实上可能比他们过去

turns.en: bit more poorly than on average how they've done over the last 10 or 20 years. I think indeed, investors are seeking out ETFs to get more diversified holdings, whether it's the broad market cap weighted ones or as Valerie was saying, other ones that still are giving you 10 or 20 different
turns.zh: 10 年、20 年的平均水平还要再差一点。所以我认为，投资者确实在借助 ETF 获得更分散的持仓——无论是宽基的市值加权产品，还是像 Valerie 说的那样，其他能给你 10 只、20 只不同

turns.en: stocks rather than really the most idiosyncratic type of stock picking.
turns.zh: 股票的产品——而不是那种最极致的个性化选股。

turns.en: Victor, to your point, you made a career at one stage in your market existence of trying to find where some of those notable statistical anomalies, the convergences and divergences, the dispersion, the correlations were actually either trending in a direction where you could capitalize
turns.zh: Victor，顺着你说的——你在市场生涯的某个阶段，正是靠寻找那些显著的统计异象为业的：收敛与背离、离散度、相关性，判断它们要么正朝着某个你可以抓住获利的方向演进，

turns.en: on it or finding arbitrage opportunities. Is this a kind of market where active stock picking, active industry or sector level picking, even asset class picking is one where you can find ways to add alpha or outperformance or are you better off just buying that index fund because overall,
turns.zh: 要么能从中发现套利（arbitrage）机会。那么现在的市场，是不是一个可以通过主动选股、主动做行业或板块选择、甚至大类资产选择来创造超额收益（alpha）、跑赢市场的市场？还是说，

turns.en: it seems to be masking a lot of the underlying kind of issues that we're seeing from a dispersion standpoint in the components of each of these individual markets. I think it really depends who you are, that when I was doing that kind of alpha-seeking activity, I was working at Solomon Brothers or
turns.zh: 与其去买那只指数基金更好？毕竟指数整体上似乎掩盖了我们在各个市场成分股离散度层面看到的诸多深层问题。我认为这真的取决于你是谁。当年我做那种追逐 alpha 的工作时，是在 Salomon Brothers 或者

turns.en: a hedge fund endowed with lots of resources and lots of intel, and we did okay at that for a period of time. But today, what we're seeing is that professionals, whether it's Citadel or Jane Street or Hudson River Trading, they're just minting money every single day. So it's an opportunity
turns.zh: 一家资源雄厚、情报充足的对冲基金，我们在那段时间做得还不错。但今天我们看到的是，专业机构——无论是 Citadel、Jane Street 还是 Hudson River Trading——每天都在像印钞一样赚钱。所以这是一个机会

turns.en: rich environment if you happen to have a billion dollars to spend on tech each year. But if you're a retail investor sitting at home and trying to find opportunities, you have to realize that probably on the other side of your trades is Ken Griffin or whoever, and it's probably not going to end
turns.zh: 极其丰富的环境——前提是你恰好每年有十亿美元可以砸在技术上。但如果你是个坐在家里找机会的散户投资者，你必须意识到，你每笔交易的对手盘很可能就是 Ken Griffin 或者别的什么高手，结局多半不会

turns.en: all that well. I mean, you might get lucky and things go well, but I think it's an environment that continues to be tough for individual non-professionals to generate alpha. The markets are just so efficient and it's so tough to do it without a lot of resources, a big team, a lot of data,
turns.zh: 太美妙。你也许运气好、顺风顺水，但我认为，对非专业的个人来说，这仍然是一个很难创造 alpha 的环境。市场实在太有效率了，没有大量资源、庞大团队、海量数据

turns.en: a lot of tech. So, as I say, I think it really depends who you are. It certainly seems like a super opportunity rich environment from what we're reading about how trading firms are making more in a higher quality way than we've ever seen in the past. It's just unprecedented. I don't know
turns.zh: 和强大的技术支持，是很难做到的。所以就像我说的，这真的取决于你是谁。从我们读到的报道看，交易公司赚钱之多、质量之高前所未有，这确实像个机会无比丰富的环境。这是史无前例的。我不知道

turns.en: how much longer it goes on. But on the other side of that has to be people that are underperforming, and this proliferation of zero-data exploration stock options and leveraged ETFs and all these different things is the channel through which money is getting siphoned out of the retail
turns.zh: 这种情况还能持续多久。但硬币的另一面，必然是一群跑输的人。零日到期股票期权（zero-day-to-expiration options，0DTE）、杠杆 ETF（leveraged ETF）这类产品的泛滥，正是资金从散户

turns.en: investors, I think, and they're just very well served by having some exposure to broader index funds overall, which again is a really big seam happening at the same time as this other theme of more speculative idiosyncratic trading is also quite elevated.
turns.zh: 投资者口袋里被抽走的通道。我认为，散户其实很适合持有一些宽基指数基金的敞口。这又是一股巨大的潮流，与另一股同样高涨的主题——更具投机性的个性化交易——同时上演。

turns.en: Valerie, those are some interesting points because there is maybe a difference between the types of investor, the types of trader that are in the marketplace right now and the objectives that they have. But there is no doubt that there is a retailization of the markets right now,
turns.zh: Valerie，这些观点很有意思，因为当下市场里的投资者类型、交易者类型以及他们的目标之间，或许存在差异。但毫无疑问，市场正在“散户化”（retailization），

turns.en: track yourself? Yes, absolutely, and we kind of track the retail investor through fund flows, through what we're seeing in the channels, but we're typically on the phone talking to institutions when they transact and ETFs. So we do get this unique lens where we kind of straddle the line and
turns.zh: 自己跟踪的机构投资者之间，存在相似或不同之处？是的，当然。我们主要通过资金流、通过渠道端的观察来跟踪散户投资者；而机构用 ETF 交易时，我们通常是在电话上直接沟通。所以我们有一个独特的视角，可以说是横跨界线，

turns.en: see both sides of this. And I would say when it comes down to the democratization, great word, but I also like to use the other D word, which is due diligence. So it's more important than ever for an individual investor to understand what they're buying. And I would like to locally
turns.zh: 两边的情况都能看到。我想说，提到“大众化”（democratization），这个词很好，但我还喜欢用另一个 D 开头的词——尽职调查（due diligence）。对个人投资者来说，搞清楚自己买的是什么，比以往任何时候都更重要。我甚至想

turns.en: say that you should be able to explain to your friend what it is in the ETF and what you're buying. turns.zh: 这么说：你应该能向你的朋友解释清楚，这只 ETF 里装的是什么、你买的到底是什么。但我认为最重要的是，ETF 是一种技术，是一种工具和载体，它把那些曾经个人投资者根本接触不到的更复杂的策略，

turns.en: to access, like you mentioned. And I think that more choice is ultimately a good thing for the end client, the end user. It's not, you know, behind big walls or impossible to reach, but it's about education first, people knowing what they're buying. And listen, we're in a four-year
turns.zh: 带到了他们面前，就像你提到的那样。我认为，更多选择对终端客户、终端用户来说终归是好事。这些策略不再被高墙挡在后面、遥不可及，但前提是教育先行，让人们知道自己买的是什么。再说，我们正处在一轮四年

turns.zh: 牛市之中，被烫伤、变得敏感的人——最近这种情况少了一些。所以，假如真发生某种尾部风险（tail risk）事件，我们且看市场会如何消化。但就目前而言，交易秩序井然，资金流很有黏性。如果
